description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Java runtime from version 8 to version 21 (LTS) to modernize the application to a supported, cloud-native capable JDK.
tasks.reason: The application currently targets Java 8, which is end-of-life for many enterprise distributions. Upgrading to Java 21 (LTS) enables modern language features, improved performance, security updates, and compatibility with current Azure tooling and cloud-native patterns. This is the prerequisite for all subsequent migration tasks.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project JDK target from Java 8 to Java 21. Update the Gradle build configuration (sourceCompatibility and targetCompatibility) and the Dockerfile base images to use Java 21. Ensure all existing source code compiles and any runtime behaviours remain equivalent under Java 21. Resolve any deprecated or removed Java APIs encountered during the upgrade.

tasks.description: Migrate hardcoded plaintext credentials from the properties file to Azure Key Vault for secure, centralized secret management.
tasks.reason: The application stores sensitive credentials (db.****** in plaintext within the paygateway.properties configuration file. This is a security risk as credentials are exposed in source control and deployment artifacts. Centralizing secrets in Azure Key Vault eliminates plaintext credential exposure and enables secret rotation without code or configuration changes.
tasks.requirements: Identify all plaintext credentials in the project (paygateway.properties and Java source files). Migrate those secrets to Azure Key Vault and update the application to retrieve them at runtime using Azure Key Vault. Use Managed Identity for authenticating to Azure Key Vault — no client secrets or connection strings should be stored in code or configuration files.

tasks.description: Migrate the SQL Server database connection from username/password authentication to Azure Managed Identity for passwordless access to Azure SQL Database.
tasks.reason: The application currently connects to SQL Server using hardcoded credentials (username 'sa', password stored in properties). Managed Identity eliminates stored credentials entirely, reduces attack surface, and aligns with Azure cloud-native security best practices for database access.
tasks.requirements: Update the database connection logic in PayGatewayConnectionFactory and PayGatewayConfig to use Azure Managed Identity for authentication against Azure SQL Database instead of username and password. Remove password-based JDBC authentication properties. Ensure the SQL Server JDBC driver is configured for Active Directory Managed Identity authentication mode.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: The project uses Apache Struts 1.3.10 and other older dependencies that may carry known security vulnerabilities. Remediating CVEs before deployment reduces risk exposure and satisfies security compliance requirements for cloud-hosted applications.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime environment established by the Java 21 upgrade task. Build tool: Gradle.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy the ZavaPayGateway application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested deployment to Azure. Azure Container Apps provides a fully managed serverless container platform with built-in scaling, Managed Identity support, and simplified operations — matching the cloud-native goals of this modernization.
tasks.requirements: Use the existing Dockerfile to containerize the application. Build and push the container image to Azure Container Registry. Deploy the application to Azure Container Apps. Configure Managed Identity on the Container App so that it can authenticate to Azure SQL Database and Azure Key Vault without stored credentials. Ensure health endpoints and environment variables are properly configured.
